nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native Markdown reader and WordPress block writer for headings, paragraphs, Pandoc-style inline emphasis/strong/link/code spans, bullet lists, and ordered lists.

wordpressScenario: Data Liberation Markdown import path that preserves editorial emphasis, source links, code spans, and ordered conversion steps as WordPress blocks.
